template: Compare the position of joint {axis} at {t1}ms and {t2}ms. Which of the following best describes its state change (tolerance of {eps_1} rad)? Answer only with 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'.

options_schema: The joint remained stationary (difference <= {eps_1}).
The joint moved to a higher positive angular position.
The joint moved to a lower negative angular position.
The telemetry data at these timestamps is missing or invalid.
answer_format.notes: Classification based on deterministic position evaluation.

template: Which of the following best describes the change in the friction proxy for joint {axis} from {t1}ms to {t2}ms (tolerance of {eps_2}%, half-window of {delta_1}ms)? Answer only with 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'.

options_schema: Friction proxy increased significantly (> {eps_2}%).
Friction proxy decreased significantly (< -{eps_2}%).
Friction proxy remained stable (within +/- {eps_2}%).
Friction proxy fluctuated without a clear directional trend.

template: What is the acceleration at {t_ms}ms? Answer only with a tensor of length 3 (three components), separated by '_'.

answer_format.notes: 3-element acceleration vector. Uses end-effector accelerometer (m/s^2) when available; otherwise computes angular acceleration from joint speed finite differences (rad/s^2).

template: What is the status of the force/torque acting on the robot at {t_ms}ms (threshold of {eps_3})? Answer only with 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'.

options_schema: No significant force/torque detected (magnitude <= {eps_3}).
Force/torque detected above threshold in the positive direction.
Force/torque detected above threshold in the negative direction.
Sensor data is out of bounds or unavailable.
answer_format.notes: Uses external force sensor when available; otherwise uses motor current magnitude as a torque proxy.

template: What is the {statistic_type} of the {signal_description} over the window [T={t1}ms, T={t2}ms]? Answer only with a numerical value in {units}.

answer_format.notes: Single float value. Evaluates basic time series telemetry literacy (e.g., understanding mean/max/min of a time series). By forcing a statistical computation over a defined time window rather than a single-point retrieval, it prevents simple text pattern-matching and establishes a mathematical baseline necessary for the later Root Cause Analysis (RCA) stage.

template: Rank the joints {joints_list} by their absolute speed at time {t_ms}ms, from highest to lowest. Answer only with a 4-letter string containing the letters A, B, C, and D in your ranked order.

answer_format.notes: Model assigns ranks. Labels A, B, C, D correspond to the 4 listed joints.

template: Which of the following joints are operating within their rated maximum speed at T={t_ms}ms? Answer only with a 4-letter string using T and F (e.g. TFTF), nothing else.

options_schema: Joint {axis_a} is within its rated maximum speed.
Joint {axis_b} is within its rated maximum speed.
Joint {axis_c} is within its rated maximum speed.
Joint {axis_d} is within its rated maximum speed.
answer_format.notes: Ground truth: for each joint i, True iff |feedback_speed_{axis_i}(t)| <= joint_speed_limit_{axis_i} from the machine KG (labelling/machines.json, keyed by machine_id). This is the simplest semantic prior question at L1: the raw signal read is trivial, but the correct threshold is only available from the KG. Without the KG, a model cannot answer reliably.

template: Evaluate the motor current of joint {axis} at T={t_ms}ms against the rated continuous current limit. Which statement is correct? Answer only with 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'.

options_schema: Current is safely within nominal limits (<= 80% of rated).
Current is near the limit (80% - 100% of rated).
Current exceeds the continuous rated limit (> 100%).
Current reading is unexpectedly zero or missing.
answer_format.notes: Ground truth evaluated against rated_current_{axis} from the machine KG. Replaces simple Yes/No with proportional bounds assessment.

template: Which of the following best describes the behaviour of {signal} for joint {axis} over the window [T={t1}ms, T={t2}ms]? Answer only with 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'.

options_schema: The signal is generally stable (fluctuations within a normal noise threshold).
The signal exhibits a clear and continuous increasing trend.
The signal exhibits a clear and continuous decreasing trend.
The signal is highly erratic or oscillating without a single directional trend.
answer_format.notes: Standardized to 4 options. Signal ∈ {effort_current, feedback_speed, feedback_pos}.

template: Based on the available data, what is the operational state of the robot at T={t_ms}ms? Answer only with 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'.

options_schema: The robot is in {state_correct}.
The robot is in {state_distractor_1}.
The robot is in {state_distractor_2}.
The robot is in {state_distractor_3}.
answer_format.notes: Uses safety_mode column mapped via KG enum when available; otherwise derives operational state from joint speed and current patterns (Idle, Standby, Normal Operation, High Load).

template: Given the {signal_description} for joint {axis} over [T={t1}ms, T={t2}ms], what will its value be at T={t3}ms? Answer only with an integer or decimal number, nothing else.

answer_format.notes: Ground truth: interpolate/extrapolate signal_{axis}(t3) from the episode data. t3 must lie within the episode but outside the context window shown. Tolerance band: +/- k% of signal range over the context window (k=10). Signal in {effort_current, feedback_speed, feedback_pos}. Horizon n = t3 - t2 sampled from [1, 5] timesteps to keep extrapolation tractable at L1. The context shown to the model is truncated at t2 so the answer cannot be read off directly.

template: Over the window [T={t1}ms, T={t2}ms], does the {signal_description} for joint {axis} contain an anomalous sample (defined as exceeding {k_sigma} standard deviations from the window mean)? Answer only with 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'.

options_schema: Yes - an upward anomaly is present (a sample exceeds mean + {k_sigma}*sigma).
Yes - a downward anomaly is present (a sample falls below mean - {k_sigma}*sigma).
No anomalous sample detected (all samples remain within +/- {k_sigma}*sigma).
Signal data is unavailable or insufficient for this window.
answer_format.notes: Pointwise z-score anomaly detection over the context window. Signal in {effort_current, feedback_speed, feedback_pos}. k_sigma sampled from {2.5, 3.0, 3.5}. If both upward and downward outliers exist, the larger absolute deviation determines A vs B.
